title: Spiritual Crystal
text: Spiritual crystals are a fundamental condensed magical material, used to build further workstations.

With a Primordial Spell Core as catalyst, a reaction cauldron or pool continuously produces Spiritual Crystals without item or fluid ingredients: 1 crystal per base 100 seconds. The core is not consumed.
They also serve as the substrate for low-tier spell crystals. Place one in the crystal processing table alongside ink and the microcores.

React 1 Spiritual Crystal into 1 Infused Spiritual Crystal over an Infused Crystal Block, or into 1 Resonance Crystal over a Resonance Core. Both reactions need no fluid, take a base 100 seconds, and preserve the catalyst block.
